name: port_scanner
description: Scan a host for open ports using nmap. Requires explicit user confirmation before any scan actually runs (port scanning a host you don't own/control can be illegal in some jurisdictions) - the first call always returns a confirmation prompt; only call again with confirm=true after the user has explicitly agreed.

action.description: scan_common: top 1000 ports (fast). scan_all: every port (slow). scan_specific: only the ports listed. version_detection: identify service versions on open ports.

host.description: The target hostname or IP address to scan. Must be a real host the user owns or has explicit permission to scan.

ports.description: Specific ports/ranges to scan (e.g. '80,443,8080' or '1-100'). Only used for action='scan_specific' or to narrow scan_all/version_detection.

aggressive.description: Use nmap's aggressive scan mode (-A). Only relevant for scan_all/scan_common. Defaults to false (stealth/SYN scan).

confirm.description: Must be explicitly true to actually execute the scan. The FIRST call for any new scan should omit this (or set false) to get a confirmation prompt for the user. Only set true after the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed - never assume confirmation.
